localizedValues.name: S1
localizedValues.description:
The S1 Kitchen Shelter is a CCC log shelter with fireplace. It has one sink with water spigot, lights, and one electrical outlet. There is parking in front of the shelter, in the designated day-use park lot, or along the exit road in the grass area with head-in parking only. Parking is limited, so carpooling is encouraged.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: Lewis & Clark Lodge
localizedValues.description:
The Lewis & Clark Lodge was originally built in 1950 to house wildland firefighter crews working in Southwest Washington. The lodge has a cozy wood stove, a fully equipped kitchen, 22 twin beds with three full restrooms in the bunkhouse sleeping area, and a private bedroom with full bed and a separate full restroom. The maximum indoor sleeping capacity is 24. Maximum total capacity is 50. Additional sleeping accommodations listed below. The lodge has plenty of space for indoor activities and relaxation. There is a large outdoor firepit. Nearby activities include hiking, biking and five miles of equestrian trails.
Renters must bring their own linens (blankets, sheets, pillows, and towels) and clean up the lodge before check out.
Parking for 10 vehicles is included with your lodge rental. Additional vehicles up to 15 will be charged the extra vehicle fee of $10 per night.
Up to 4 RVs/trailers are allowed for a fee of $31 per night. NO Hookups available at the Lodge.
Please call the park for the tent policy.
NOTE: CUT OFF DATE FOR MAKING RESERVATIONS AT GROUP VACATION RENTALS IS THREE DAYS PRIOR TO ARRIVAL DATE.

localizedValues.description: This first come first served site is designated as a walk-in, bicycle-in site. Campers with vehicles are not allowed to occupy site. No vehicle drop off. One tent only. No vehicles permitted.
